 Key points
 Funeral expenses for an insured person go up from ₹15,000 to ₹20,000 per case. 
 Confinement expenses, paid where there is no ESI facility for the delivery, double from ₹7,500 to ₹15,000. 
 The contribution to keep ESI medical care goes up from ₹10 to ₹50 a month (₹600 a year). Under the old rules, retired members paid this. 
 The new rates apply to cases on or after 8 May 2026, ESIC said in a circular of 3 November. 
 Advertisement
 New Delhi, 5 November: The Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has raised the money it pays towards an insured person’s funeral to ₹20,000, from ₹15,000. Confinement expenses double to ₹15,000. The new rates apply to cases on or after 8 May 2026, ESIC headquarters said in a circular dated 3 November.
 8 May 2026 is when the Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026 were published and came into force. They replaced the old ESI (Central) Rules.
 What changes
 Old rate New rate 
 Funeral expenses ₹15,000 ₹20,000 per case 
 Confinement expenses ₹7,500 ₹15,000 per case 
 Contribution to keep medical benefit ₹10 a month ₹50 a month (₹600 a year) 
 The old rates are from the ESI (Central) Rules, 1950. The new ones are in Rules 21, 22(4) and 25(10)–(11) of the 2026 rules. The ₹20,000 funeral figure was published by ESIC in the Gazette of India on 7 October 2026.
 What each one is
 Funeral expenses are paid towards the last rites of an insured person who dies.
 Confinement expenses are paid for a delivery that happens where ESI medical facilities are not available. Under the old rules, they were paid for two deliveries only.
 The medical-benefit contribution lets a person keep ESI medical care after leaving work. Under the old rules, this was for an insured person who retired after at least five years, or who left work after a permanent disability from an injury at work. It covered them and their spouse, and was paid a year at a time.
 Cases since 8 May
 The new rates apply from 8 May 2026, though ESIC issued this circular only on 3 November. It does not say whether families already paid the old amount since then will get the difference. ESIC said it has already updated its insurance software for the new rates, and sent a user manual to its offices.
 The circular is signed by Chandan Prabhakar, Deputy Director (Benefit-II).
 Source: Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (Headquarters), circular No. N-12015/2/2026-Benefit-II, 3 November 2026; ESI (Central) Rules, 1950 (as on 25 August 2023), Rules 56A, 59, 60 and 61.

 Critical AdSense behaviour: adsbygoogle.push({}) does NOT bind to
 a specific . It says "process the next unbound in DOM
 order." So if you push N times, AdSense binds the first N 
 slots it finds.
 Live investigation (2026-05-29) showed the right sidebar still
 loading late on indianpaycalculator.in. DOM order of :
 1. LEFT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-left)
 2-5. Display banners (4× AdBanner inside page content)
 6. RIGHT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-right, after main slot)
 7. Mobile anchor (StickyAnchorAd at body end)
 Previously this script pushed twice (one per sidebar). Those 2
 pushes bound LEFT + Display#1, NOT LEFT + RIGHT. The other 5
 slots only got bound as AdBanner.client:visible islands hydrated
 on scroll — meaning the right sidebar was bound 6th, after the
 user scrolled past every in-page banner. That's the "right side
 opens very late" complaint.
 Fix: push once per SSR'd ad slot. AdSense binds them all in DOM
